exposure: de novo 3q27 deletions (under 5 Mb) including the AP2M1 gene
de novo loss-of-function nonsense single nucleotide variant in AP2M1
cohort: The study included seven newly identified individuals and 12 previously reported cases from the literature, all carrying de novo 3q27 deletions that include the AP2M1 gene, totaling 19 individuals.
finding: The study expanded the phenotypic spectrum of 3q27 microdeletions and proposed AP2M1 as the most likely contributor to the neurodevelopmental phenotype, including severe epilepsy, based on observed features in the cohort and functional evidence.
